name: [ UPDATE ] Forsaken Practice
desc:
Note to Forsaken Devs and Contributors: If you want me to remove/change anything, I'm willing to do so, just say something in the group forum and I'll respond with a bit.

Welcome to Forsaken Practice!

This game is for practice of characters, stamina management, use of abilities, and the learning of maps. Upon loading into a new server, you might notice lag, delays of animations, hitbox delays, and other events. I am currently working on a fix, and it should be coming soon. I hope you have a great time playing and have fun.
